## Personality

Simon Fletcher is described as an old, cranky, and aggravating individual. His presence is noted for being a hindrance to others, who find themselves able to accomplish tasks only when he is not around.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Weddings P14](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0014)_

## History

Simon Fletcher is a wealthy man who enters a relationship with [Jane](../character/jane.md). Their romance progresses to the point of an impending marriage, making local news among Jane's acquaintances.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Weddings P3](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0003), [v3 ch.Weddings P5](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0005), [v3 ch.Weddings P9](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0009), [v3 ch.Weddings P10](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0010), [v3 ch.Weddings P11](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0011), [v3 ch.Weddings P12](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0012), +25 more_
